search: Exa returned 20 results across four philosophical search workstreams. Four philosophical sources were fetched and consulted; duplicate and unattributed reposts were excluded. Model cards were checked separately from pinned local files.

sources.title: Sigmund Freud, Remembering, Repeating and Working-Through (1914)
sources.quality: Primary essay in an archival transcription; historical theory, not validation of AI diagnosis.
sources.use: Repetition, transference, and the effects of the analytic situation.

sources.title: Adrian Johnston, Jacques Lacan, Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, sections 2.3 and 2.4.1
sources.quality: Scholarly reference explaining primary concepts; revised 2026.

sources.title: G. W. F. Hegel, Phenomenology of Spirit, paragraphs 178-196
sources.quality: Primary text in an archival English translation.
sources.use: Reciprocal recognition and the inadequacy of one-sided recognition.

sources.title: Slavoj Zizek, The Big Other Does Not Exist (1997)
sources.quality: Author essay reproduced from Journal of European Psychoanalysis; primary theoretical argument.
sources.use: Symbolic fictions and the efficacy of a role even without literal belief.
